'''Nazish''' was a [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] [[Zulirian Swordmasters|Zulirian Swordmistress]]. She was one of only three individuals to have mastered the aerial sword combat known as [[Trispzest]]. Although the other two individuals, [[Maw (Dark Jedi)|Maw]] and [[Kharys]] used a lightsaber with this technique, as a Zulirian Swordmistress, it is likely that Nazish used a simple blade in place of a lightsaber.
